acceptance: Verified completed or imported files enter native shared metadata with path, name, size, hashset, and AICH fields.
evidence: SharedFileStore accepts completed and imported metadata, validates ED2K hashsets through disk truth, trims names, stores path/name/size/hashset/AICH/origin/verified ranges, and replaces duplicate root hashes without known.met import.

acceptance: Shared files produce server and Kad publish records only when sharing is enabled.
evidence: Publish records are empty when sharing is disabled. Enabled records include file hash, name, size, hashset, AICH root, server tags, and Kad source-publish payloads using the existing Kad publish builder.

acceptance: Upload responder reads verified ranges safely from shared files.
evidence: read_verified_range rejects missing files, invalid ranges, and unverified ranges before reading from disk, then returns only the requested verified bytes or a typed read error.
